name: bookcraft
description: L3 egui desktop shelf for BookCraft (calls bookcraft-core in-process)

tools.name: book_status
tools.description: Report BookCraft version, the ebook-convert engine, and optional library health.

tools.name: book_list
tools.description: List books newest first.

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Substring search over title, author sort, authors, series, tags and descriptions.

tools.name: book_info
tools.description: Full metadata for one book: description, format files, cover path.

tools.name: book_grep
tools.description: Search book text when Calibre's full-text-search.db exists, else titles and descriptions. Returns the engine used.

tools.name: book_stats
tools.description: Library-wide book/author/tag/series counts and format distribution.

tools.name: book_schema
tools.description: Dump the Calibre schema (sqlite_master): tables, indexes and triggers.

tools.name: book_backup
tools.description: Take a timestamped metadata backup outside the library. Writes take one automatically.

tools.name: book_init
tools.description: Create a fresh Calibre-shaped library directory. Refuses when one exists.

tools.name: book_update
tools.description: Set metadata fields on one book via Calibre itself. Takes a backup first.

tools.name: book_add
tools.description: Add a book file (or an empty record with empty=true) via Calibre itself. Takes a backup first.

tools.name: book_remove
tools.description: Remove one book via Calibre itself (Recycle Bin unless permanent=true). Takes a backup first.

tools.name: book_add_format
tools.description: Attach one format file to a book via Calibre itself (replaces the format when present).

tools.name: book_remove_format
tools.description: Drop one format from a book via Calibre itself. A no-op when absent.

tools.name: book_rename
tools.description: Rename a tag, author, series or publisher. Merges when the new name exists.

tools.name: book_duplicates
tools.description: Books sharing a normalised title: duplicate candidates.

tools.name: book_series_gaps
tools.description: Series with missing volume numbers.

tools.name: book_unread
tools.description: Books never opened (or everything when the library has no tracking table).

tools.name: book_reading_stats
tools.description: Totals, read/unread split, rating histogram, additions by year, top tags/authors.

tools.name: book_export
tools.description: Export the library (or one search) as CSV or JSON to out.

tools.name: book_excerpt
tools.description: Paginated chapter text from an EPUB (or a raw window from a TXT).

tools.name: book_open
tools.description: Open the best file with the system default application (desktop affordance).

tools.name: book_random
tools.description: A random book, optionally filtered by tag, author or format.

tools.name: book_collection_save
tools.description: Save a named search (a smart collection).

tools.name: book_collection_list
tools.description: List saved searches.

tools.name: book_collection_run
tools.description: Run a saved search.

tools.name: book_collection_delete
tools.description: Delete a saved search.

tools.name: book_bulk_update
tools.description: Update the same fields on many books, all-or-nothing in one transaction.

tools.name: book_convert
tools.description: Convert one book with ebook-convert into out_dir. Never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: book_ingest
tools.description: Turn a saved HTML page into a Markdown artifact (Readly-style ingest without a browser).
